en.headline: Pilotless eVTOL completes maiden Hong Kong flight at Cyberport
en.dek: EHang’s EH216-S, carrying a robot, flew a preset route at the Cyberport waterfront vertiport as part of the government’s low-altitude economy regulatory sandbox trials.
body: An autonomous electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft completed its first public demonstration flight in Hong Kong on Friday at Cyberport’s waterfront vertiport X.

The flight involved EHang’s flagship EH216-S pilotless model, operated in partnership with Cyberport and Kwoon Chung Smart Mobility under the government’s Low-Altitude Economy Regulatory Sandbox X programme. The aircraft carried a robot and followed a preset route to test stability in the harbour-side environment.

Organisers said the trials, which continue through Sunday with multiple sorties, aim to gather data for future regulatory rules and to support possible cross-boundary passenger and logistics routes. The project is among the first batch of unconventional aircraft pilots selected for the sandbox.

zh.headline: 無人駕駛eVTOL於數碼港完成香港首航試飛
zh.dek: 億航EH216-S搭載機械人在數碼港海濱垂直起降機場完成預設航線飛行，屬政府低空經濟監管沙盒X首批試點。
body: 一架自動駕駛電動垂直起降飛行器周五在數碼港海濱「垂直起降機場X」完成香港公開示範飛行。
是次試飛使用億航智能旗艦機款EH216-S無人駕駛型號，由數碼港與冠忠智慧出行合作，屬政府低空經濟「監管沙盒X」首批非傳統航空器試點項目。飛行器搭載機械人，按預設航線飛行，驗證海濱環境下的運行穩定性。
主辦方表示，8月28日至30日期間將持續進行多架次公開飛行，收集數據以協助制訂相關監管規則，並為日後開通跨境客運及物流低空航線奠定基礎。
